title: Onchain analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single rug-pull operation
message_html: Onchain analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single rug-pull operation ...
snippet: The creators of 10 Pons V2 launches exempted a set of wallets from Pons' anti-sniping tax; those wallets went on to buy most of each token's supply, per onchain data.
